format: UTF-8 tab separated, header row; empty numeric value is null

contracts.offlist: All three datasets count strict physical reads. A physical ID with multiple assignment rows is wholly excluded, including identical duplicates.
contracts.correction: Within each class collapse original-read–target pairs; classes can overlap. No source means unknown, not noncatalog. Percent denominator O includes all pairs to target.
contracts.identity: Each offlist target is the actual supplied nucleotide barcode; pairing requires dataset,replicate,barcode.
contracts.zero: Targets with zero assignments retained; percent is null when O=0. Tool-unselected targets explicitly selected_by_tool=0.
